short_description: Procedural geomorphology derived from accepted G7 semantic fields and G3/G5/G6 surface, feature and hydrology truth.
purpose: Add deterministic valley, river-channel, bank, floodplain and erosion/deposition shaping without taking ownership of persistent Matter mutations, world identity, authority, persistence or material ontology.
expected_outcome: A replaceable, provenance-friendly geomorphology layer that produces stable surface deformation independent from SurfaceCellKey, LOD, camera and representation and can later feed geology/volume/detail stages.
progress_note: G8.2 River Channel Incision is ACCEPTED after exact-Windows full acceptance on tested head 491fe10877c70c362c14ab595a8a0204165a880a. The final gate reports G8.1 parent PASS, G8.2 river-channel PASS, valley+river composition PASS, geomorphology ownership PASS, world/core regression through NX4 PASS, RL3 representation-aware streaming 175 assertions, RL3 process streaming 37 assertions, main_scene_cli_all 6 PASS / 0 FAIL, STOPPED lifecycle and CLEAN working tree. The accepted implementation interprets geo/river-width-m as full channel width, uses half-width around the canonical G6 centerline, preserves the accepted G8.1 valley component and adds only river_channel_delta_m with a smooth outer edge. Bank, floodplain and erosion/deposition remain zero. G8.2 does not own SurfaceCellKey, LOD, Matter, authority, persistence, material ontology or network replication. Next frontier is G8.3 Banks and Floodplain Shaping.
next_stage: Implement G8.3 Banks and Floodplain Shaping as a replaceable composition layer over accepted G8.2, then run focused and full Windows acceptance before G8.4 Erosion / Deposition Baseline.
